LanguageData.SW_BeastRoar.label: terrifying roar
LanguageData.SW_BeastRoar.description: This creature has been shaken by the powerful roar of a colossal creature.
LanguageData.SW_ForceFocus.label: force focus
LanguageData.SW_ForceFocus.description: A heightened awareness generated by an animals pack instinct and innate connection to the Force.
LanguageData.SW_Rampage.label: rampage
LanguageData.SW_Rampage.description: Reverted by fierce instincts this creature has driven itself into a adrenlaline fuelled manhunting rage. Every muscle is at peak performance and it has become numb to damage for a short time.
LanguageData.SW_SootheSong.label: soothing song
LanguageData.SW_SootheSong.description: This person has been heard the beautiful call of a majestic creature.
LanguageData.SW_Spat.label: spat on
LanguageData.SW_Spat.description: This person has been spat on by a creature.
LanguageData.SW_Spur.label: spurred
LanguageData.SW_Spur.description: Triggering it's own "fight or fligh" instincts this creature has driven itself into a adrenlaline fuelled rush. It will move and breath twice as effectively as usual.
LanguageData.SW_Webbed.label: webbed
LanguageData.SW_Webbed.description: This person has been webbed by a creature.
